question: Can the selected heuristic parser serve alone as a lossless Unicode-character input boundary?
scope: A0-betatest parse_semantic only; no claim about the full engine, learned inference, linguistic equivalence, or current a0
criterion: Every required-distinction pair must produce different complete SemanticFeatures dictionaries. Identical-repeat and known-distinction controls must behave as specified.

outcomes.SURVIVED: All frozen distinctions survive; expand to a source/gonol/occurrence adapter fixture. No universal sufficiency claim.
outcomes.FALSIFIED: At least one required distinction collides with valid controls; exclude this parser as the sole character-input representation. Retain it only as an optional derived heuristic view.
outcomes.BLOCKED: Source identity, plan validity, import, call, serialization, determinism, or control failure; repair the prerequisite before interpretation.

stop_condition: Evaluate every frozen pair twice per side, record all observations, then classify once.

resource_preflight.data: 9 short synthetic pairs; no user records
resource_preflight.compute: 36 parser calls; no training or model API
resource_preflight.operational_risk: local source execution after immutable identity check
resource_preflight.execution_durability: one foreground process; receipt written only after complete evaluation

maximal_program: Admit lawful character-gonol input; consume the UCNS neural audit; derive PTCNA construction; establish weight/state-sensitive inference and readout; evaluate generalization; integrate the accepted contract in a0.
hmmm: Passing a finite distinction set cannot establish input sufficiency or neural inference.
Future UCNS/PTCNA construction and UCHC release/reconsumption remain separate gates.
design: Source-informed directed counterexample search frozen before execution; not blinded or a representative benchmark.
